requiredConstruction: Model a complete closed palace landmark, not a front facade and not a cluster of spheres. The overall silhouette must be broad, stepped, architectural, and source-led.
Use reusable bevelled modular tower components: polygonal/cylindrical inhabited drums, arched window recesses, honeycomb-ribbed shallow cupolas, eaves, finials, buttresses, and stair/portal pieces.
The royal portal must be the front contrast anchor: broad purple double doors behind a deep gold honey arch, readable bee crest, center seam, handles, warm dark reveal, and grounded stairs.
Exactly four dominant front bay towers must be countable at front, 45-degree, 315-degree, clay, and phone views. Each is a true closed volume with occupied dark window cells and actual side returns.

Create continuous gold-bronze tracery using bevelled curves or closed tube meshes attached to tower walls and cupolas. The honeycomb pattern must wrap corners and remain structural, not float as sparse hex badges.

Cupolas must be shallow segmented civic domes with external honeycomb/radial cage ribs and varied hierarchy. Avoid generic mound, egg/gourd masses, simple cones, smooth onion bulbs, mosque silhouette, or many equal towers.

Use physically based materials: metallic rough gold/bronze, warm wax stone, near-black occupied recesses, emissive/transmissive amber glazing, glossy deep purple enamel, and amber honey with transmission/clearcoat-like specular response.

Honey must originate under ledges/channels as a thick convex shelf, sagging curtain, multiple fused ropes, beads, and weighted terminal drops. It must look delicious and viscous in dedicated close proof; no rectangular cardboard sheet or lamp/post silhouette.
Author the rear and sides with fewer but real windows, honeycomb ribs, buttresses, service doorway/aperture, honey channels, and subordinate roof rhythm.

Source images may be loaded as non-rendering Blender reference planes only. No source or generated pixels may be exported as runtime texture, camera projection, facade card, alpha billboard, or emitted image plane.
Export one optimized GLB, validate that runtime loads it, and capture evidence from the same exported geometry/materials.

capture.render: Blender headless from the exported GLB or export-identical scene, transparent/neutral studio background, fixed cameras, no UI overlays
capture.integrity: immutable r01; write renders first, manifest last, then independently hash GLB, blend, script, runtime integration, and every evidence image
capture.gate: Every required category at least 0.85. One blockout plus one bounded correction. Hard veto for mound/egg/gourd, cardboard honey, source projection, card/disk/shard/open shell, simple cones/onion fort, fewer than four countable bays, or weak phone identity.
